components.css: .ds-trow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:4px 14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 8px 12px 12px;border-top:1px solid #E2DCCB;color:#23262B;font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-star{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1.5px solid #8A8678;color:#62666E;background:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}.ds-star:hover{transform:scale(1.18);border-color:var(--gB,#F04A68)}.ds-star:focus-visible,.ds-dn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gA,#A50E28);outline-offset:2px}.ds-tt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px}.ds-tt::before{content:'';width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#8A4D00;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(138,77,0,.22)}.ds-ts{color:#62666E;font-size:13px;padding-left:18px}.ds-pill{padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:#1B7550;background:rgba(27,117,80,.15)}.ds-dn{padding:8px 15px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid rgba(27,117,80,.7);color:#1B7550;background:none;font:800 13.5px Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),background-color .2s,color .2s}.ds-dn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.07);background:#1B7550;color:#FFFEF9}.ds-dn:active{transform:scale(.9)}

narrative.overview: A signed-in task tracker used several times a day by one owner, built like the cabin of a fine car at night: dark grey and ivory surfaces, warm ivory text, and a single gemstone accent that shows up as thin light along edges rather than as decoration over content. The owner picks the gem (Ruby by default, Sapphire, Emerald, Amethyst, Topaz); everything accent-coloured follows it. Light and dark are both first-class, as is a system mode. Motion is a setting (Off, Subtle 9s, Full 4s).
keyCharacteristics: Dark grey and ivory ground; accent only as light, thin fills and focus.
One owner-selected gem, three tokens per gem (deep, mid, bright) in each mode.
Priority colour (neutral, amber, signal orange) is a separate channel from the accent.
Marcellus for headings and large numerals; Manrope for everything operable.
Springy micro-interactions on every control; all of it switches off with Motion Off.

rules.name: The Light Not Paint Rule
rules.body: The gem appears as edge light, thin lines, glows and filled controls. It is never a large flat panel behind content.

rules.name: The Two Channels Rule
rules.body: Accent means the app's light or an active control. Priority and state colours (amber, signal orange, green, danger) carry meaning and never change with the gem.

rules.name: The Ring Rule
rules.body: Focus ring, input focus border and chart primary line use one colour (--ring). Control borders use the stronger --ctl neutral so unfilled controls stay visible.

rules.name: The Operable Sans Rule
rules.body: Anything clickable, typeable or status-bearing is Manrope. Marcellus is for headings and large numerals only.

rules.name: The Slow Light Rule
rules.body: Ambient light travels at 4s or slower per cycle, moves via transform or registered custom properties only, and must have a static Off pose.

dos: Do take every accent from --gA, --gM, --gB so the owner's gem choice carries everywhere; use deep to mid for filled controls and bright for light.
Do keep priority and state colours independent of the accent.
Do give every ambient or micro-interaction animation a Motion Off pose and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use Marcellus only for headings and big numerals, Manrope for everything else.
Do let cards respond to their own width with container queries.
Do put white text only on gem gradients and danger fills; keep unfilled control borders on --ctl.
donts: Don't paint large flat panels or text blocks in the gem colour; it is light and thin fills.
Don't use the accent to signal priority, status or danger.
Don't add hard offset shadows or glitter-style decoration.
Don't let ambient light animate layout properties; transform and registered custom properties only.
Don't keep the pulse or sheen on touch devices (pointer:coarse).
